_doc: CONDITIONAL REVEALS and REPEATER ROW SHAPES for the guided online N-400. Captured live on draft 13370795, 2026-07-30, by setting gate answers with a React-safe value setter and re-reading the DOM. Companion to n400-online-field-dump.json (which holds the unconditional shape). Answers were NOT committed with Next, so anything that only appears after a commit is marked as such.

THE_BIG_RULE.rule: Every moral-character field whose name ends in '.question' has a SIBLING '<same-path>.additionalExplanation' TEXTAREA that is revealed by answering the radio Yes (true). A field WITHOUT the '.question' suffix has NO explain sibling.
THE_BIG_RULE.negative_control: Setting involvedInTorture.question=true revealed ONLY its own additionalExplanation — genocide/killing/intentionallyHarming stayed collapsed. So the reveal is strictly per-question, not per-page.
THE_BIG_RULE.why_it_matters: This covers roughly 35 moral-character explain fields MECHANICALLY — the map and descriptor can DERIVE them instead of capturing each one. It is also where SOF-1066's 28 orphaned Good Moral Character explain answers belong ONLINE: each goes to its own '<x>.additionalExplanation', NOT to a Part 14 continuation sheet (that is a paper-only construct).
THE_BIG_RULE.descriptor_note: Each additionalExplanation should be declared cond(area(...), {by: '<x>.question', is: 'true'}) so the chain drives the radio first and can tell a legitimate non-reveal from a real failure.

evidence_pages_are_CONDITIONAL.finding: The /evidence/* page set is NOT fixed — it changes with the answers, the same way the I-539's evidence pages vary by target status. Three different sets were observed live.

maps_onto_our_doc_requirements./evidence/your-current-spouse-us-citizen: the spouse_citizenship group (us_birth_certificate / us_passport / naturalization_certificate / fs240) — already gated on applicant.eligibility_basis == spouse_3yr in document_requirements.json, which is EXACTLY the condition that reveals this page
maps_onto_our_doc_requirements./evidence/evidence-about-your-marriage: the spouse_bona_fide group (joint_lease_mortgage / joint_bank_statement / joint_tax_return), same gate
maps_onto_our_doc_requirements./evidence/additional-evidence: server-side catch_all for everything with no dedicated slot — green_card, tax_transcript, passport, drivers_license, arrest_record, etc.

evidence_pages_are_CONDITIONAL.implication: The backend upload_pages for N-400 needs a conditional filter like the I-539's 'targets', but keyed on applicant.eligibility_basis (and possibly marital status) rather than a target status code. Reuse the SOF-1009 mechanism in forms/resolvers.py myuscis_documents.
evidence_pages_are_CONDITIONAL.CAVEAT: Uncommitted answers REVERT on navigation — myUSCIS only persists on Next. So this list is what the sidebar OFFERS transiently, and the definitive per-scenario set still needs a Next-committed walk. Not yet done. Upload controls on these pages are also unconfirmed: all of them BOUNCE on a URL deep-link.
evidence_pages_are_CONDITIONAL.not_yet_seen: No dedicated green-card or tax-transcript slot appeared in any of the three variants, which is consistent with them falling to the catch-all.

repeaters.note: Unlike the CURRENT address block on /about-you/your-contact-information, this row's toDate has a proper Formik name. The UUID-named To field is specific to the current-address block.

POLYMORPHIC.note: ONE repeater with FOUR row shapes. The row renders ONLY the type field until a type is chosen; each type then reveals a different field set. Only the 'Add an employer' shape is captured below — self-employment, unemployment and school shapes are STILL UNCAPTURED.

repeaters.maps_to_our_facts: applicant.employment_education_history[i].{name -> employmentInfo.workName, occupation_or_field -> employmentInfo.occupation, from -> dates.fromDate, to -> dates.toDate, city/state/country -> address.*}. Clean fit.
repeaters.sof_1066_note: SOF-1066 records that the PDF has NO 'To' widget on Part 7 row 1, so a to-date on the first row is dropped on paper. ONLINE there IS a proper dates.toDate plus a dates.toPresent checkbox, so the online fill does not have that hole.

NESTED_REPEATER.WARNING: This is a TWO-LEVEL repeater — a list of countries inside each trip row. No existing descriptor models this: RepeaterSpec carries a single namePrefix + addButtonText, so the type needs extending (or the inner list needs special-casing) before this page can be driven. First occurrence of a nested repeater in the whole extension.

repeaters.sof_1066_note: Matches SOF-1066's Part 6 children columns exactly: name, residence, relationship, providing-support. The online question text already says 'ALL children under 18 years of age', corroborating the 'of any age' -> 'under 18' relabel.

repeaters.note: Same name and shape as the I-130's applicant.yourName.additionalNames.otherNames repeater — that map block transfers.
Add label is IDENTICAL to the I-539's. Row field names not yet captured (Add not clicked). The I-539 uses additionalInformationArray; confirm whether the N-400 does too before assuming.

in_page_reveals.note: This is the legal-name-change block. Pairs with the name_change_document doc requirement.

in_page_reveals.SOF_1066: THIS IS PDF PART 2 ITEM 12.c — the SSA consent SOF-1066 says must be added because 'a Yes on 12.a with a blank 12.c means no card is issued'. The online field name is consentForDisclosure. It is a radio, revealed by 12.a = Yes.

in_page_reveals.note: Setting numberOfTimesMarried=2 revealed NOTHING further on this page, so the current-spouse detail block and the prior-marriage rows must live on page(s) that only appear after a Next-commit. NOT captured.

in_page_reveals.SOF_1066: Covers the Part 9 Item 30.a nobility-titles TEXT that SOF-1066 adds. Online it is titleOfNobility.additionalExplanation, plus an extra willingToGiveUpTitle radio that has no PDF counterpart in the ticket's list — worth checking whether the paper form has it.

needs_a_next_committed_walk: The Part 9 Item 15 CRIME TABLE. Setting committedCrime=true AND arrested=true on /moral-character/crimes-and-offenses revealed NOTHING in-page, so the table is on a page that only appears once the answers are committed. This is the online counterpart of SOF-1066's applicant.mc_crime_incidents work and it is still unknown.
